name: STAC Catalog (v1.0.0)
abstract: A SpatioTemporal Asset Catalogs (STAC) catalog, version 1.0.0.  This building block implements validation of examples using the canonical schema and a JSON-LD context to a map to a RDF format that can support richer logical constraints and integration with related data.

examples.content: Ref to STAC example using version (1.0.0)

- $ref: https://ogcincubator.github.io/bblocks-stac/build/annotated/contrib/stac/catalog/schema.yaml
- type: object
